label: Must this recording's picture be re-encoded before it is handed out?

params.name: codec
params.label: The picture format ffmpeg found in the recording

params.name: portable_codecs
params.label: Formats that may be kept as they are

description_nl: TRUE when the narrated video must be re-encoded to H.264 first. A recording already in a portable format is copied, which is fast and loses nothing; HEVC, VP9, AV1 or an unreadable format is re-encoded, so nobody is asked to buy a codec to watch it.
weight_basis: Owner-only (audience admin): loosening this hands out videos some people cannot play without paying for a codec.
